title: November 15 — stored histories, missing waves and worlds within worlds
summary: Five missing repositories join the census (640 → 645). The workshop and V30 distinguish transient memory from grown structure; Astra tests actual waveform recall and records a negative. AlgoWorld1 and Algoworld2 turn the lab/vine lineage into multiscale browser worlds. PerceptionLabNodes and all seven November 14 projects were already present and are not duplicated. Experiment 011 remains ongoing at this snapshot.

nodes.claim: Experimental workshop reusing PerceptionLab nodes, with numbered hypotheses, host-order runners, controls, receipts and GUI workflows.
nodes.survived: Repository-reported 009: grown AB/BA structure survives a complete activity wipe and is read from an identical probe response in 89/96 held-out bodies; growth off 48/96 and scrambled destinations 55/96. 010 age-hardening retained 84/96 first histories after twenty opposite episodes, an exploratory observation.
nodes.killed: 009 cue recall and pruning protection failed. 008 self-tuned returns scored 60/96 versus 81/96 fixed returns. 010 use-hardening missed its pre-stated test (p=0.064). 011 dual-history protocol is committed and ongoing at this review; preflight/smoke success is not a scientific result. These upstream experiments were not rerun for this pass.

nodes.claim: The Order of Falls: a synthesis of the PerceptionLabAI fade-triggered wave experiments, with a separate single-loop reproduction receipt and later corrections.
nodes.survived: Documents delayed-feedback rhythms, suppression/turn-taking, readable order in ongoing pulse trains, and the move from transient dynamics to grown structural memory. Keeps the 007 one-way-dependence correction and the 008 reversal of the earlier third-unit interpretation.
nodes.killed: The fade-triggered unit is explicitly not a port of native GeometricNeuron V26–V29 equations. This is a research write-up, not another independently trained architecture. Reusing PerceptionLabAI results here does not double the evidence.

nodes.claim: Astra tests whether locally state-shaped packets let three grown fade-triggered units reconstruct a missing ABC/ACB wave from A alone after a full activity wipe. A concurrent Fable follow-up tests Gemini’s signed predictive-damping proposal with a 24-timer bank; its preregistered cancellation criterion is distinct and results are pending at this checkpoint.
nodes.survived: Full 96-body recall batch reproduced after restoring the flattened vendor/traces layout; parsed results match original except runtime. Separate known-physics least-squares inverse: 32 mixtures, median amplitude error 0.253%, held-out waveform score 0.9999983; inverse receipt and summary reproduce exactly.
nodes.killed: All recall arms fail: median errors 182.2%, 168.4%, 166.6%, 179.3% against 100% passive baseline; state-shaped own-order preference 11/24. Fixed two-frame packets match per-packet area and squared drive; original impulse and whole episodes are not energy-matched. Twelve paired schedules, not 96 independent replicates. Known inverse dictionary is supplied, not learned.

nodes.claim: A browser world that zooms through different live algorithms: planet, landscape, grove, bark, cell and a return to planet.
nodes.survived: README describes explicit four-number downward couplings and switches, a port of the 59-tick PerceptionLab ECG loop as shared clock, and different procedural/simulation laws at each depth. Published browser entry point is linked.
nodes.killed: An artistic computational construction, not a measured multiscale physical model. Reported rendering tests used a software renderer; real-GPU performance is unmeasured. Simulation states are not guaranteed bit-identical across machines and upward coupling is only via the clock.

nodes.claim: A new 3D interpretation joining AlgoWorld1 scale changes with Koynnos-style trees, vines and crystals; zoom branches into slime tubes or a crystal lattice.
nodes.survived: README describes instanced 3D geometry, a live Physarum-agent/oscillator simulation on the approached branch and a wave field on the approached crystal. Planet is static apart from clouds; no ECG heartbeat is used.
nodes.killed: New implementation inspired by Koynnos, not a copy of its vine engine; no load, breaking, light sensing or death. Slime is not SlimeBody pressure-flow physics. Only the visited surface simulates and branches regrow from seed on return. Source-reported software-renderer performance only.

edges.why: The workshop explicitly reuses PerceptionLab node classes and host scheduling, with reusable changes proposed upstream.
The workshop links the node inventory/audit and adopts port-effect checks; this is documentary/methodological convergence, not an asserted code fork.
V30 explicitly identifies PerceptionLabAI as the implementation and receipts behind this write-up.
Both investigate firing tied to fading history; V30 explicitly isolates that idea with different equations rather than porting the native GN.
Vendored 009 core, fade and growth nodes from pinned workshop revision 54b20b90b9356d7d622695ad9072b07ce569c5f7; new three-event assay and pulse-shape wrapper.
WaveFieldNode and PulseSourceNode are pinned source snapshots at 0291f579123ce4261aade4e6c5a7b040f8177f1e.
js/ecg.js is documented as a port of the lab ECG loop, preserving its 59-tick rhythm at saved settings.
Algoworld2 explicitly keeps the earlier zoom-between-laws idea in a newly written 3D world; this edge does not assert source-code inheritance.
README credits Koynnos-style 3D trees/vines/crystals and instanced pools, and explicitly says its vine engine is not imported.
SlimeBody inspires the surface organism metaphor; the README distinguishes its pressure/flow engine from this Physarum-agent simulation.

motifs.title: A readable record is not yet reconstruction
motifs.description: History can persist in branches and be read by an external decoder while a cue fails to regenerate its missing sensory consequence. Supplying an inverse dictionary demonstrates a separate capability; learning that map remains open.
